def _get_agent_tools(self, finding_data: Dict[str, Any]) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """Define tools available to the agent"""
    
    tools = [
        {
            "type": "function",
            "function": {
                "name": "analyze_azure_resource",
                "description": "Analyze current Azure resource configuration",
                "parameters": {
                    "type": "object",
                    "properties": {
                        "resource_id": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "description": "Azure resource ID to analyze"
                        },
                        "resource_type": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "description": "Type of Azure resource"
                        }
                    },
                    "required": ["resource_id", "resource_type"]
                }
            }
        },
        {
            "type": "function",
            "function": {
                "name": "generate_azure_commands",
                "description": "Generate Azure CLI and PowerShell commands for remediation",
                "parameters": {
                    "type": "object",
                    "properties": {
                        "action": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "description": "Action to perform (enable, disable, configure, etc.)"
                        },
                        "resource_type": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "description": "Type of Azure resource"
                        },
                        "parameters": {
                            "type": "object",
                            "description": "Additional parameters for the command"
                        }
                    },
                    "required": ["action", "resource_type"]
                }
            }
        },
        {
            "type": "function",
            "function": {
                "name": "validate_security_configuration",
                "description": "Validate security configuration after remediation",
                "parameters": {
                    "type": "object",
                    "properties": {
                        "resource_id": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "description": "Azure resource ID to validate"
                        },
                        "security_control": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "description": "Security control to validate"
                        }
                    },
                    "required": ["resource_id", "security_control"]
                }
            }
        },
        {
            "type": "function",
            "function": {
                "name": "check_cis_compliance",
                "description": "Check CIS compliance status for specific control",
                "parameters": {
                    "type": "object",
                    "properties": {
                        "cis_control": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "description": "CIS control to check"
                        },
                        "resource_id": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "description": "Azure resource ID to check"
                        }
                    },
                    "required": ["cis_control"]
                }
            }
        }
    ]
    
    return tools

// frontend/src/components/AgentManagement/AgentTab.tsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  Box,
  Typography,
  Paper,
  Button,
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableContainer,
  TableHead,
  TableRow,
  Chip,
  IconButton,
  Dialog,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogContent,
  DialogActions,
  TextField,
  FormControl,
  InputLabel,
  Select,
  MenuItem,
  LinearProgress,
  Alert,
  Card,
  CardContent,
  Grid,
  Tooltip
} from '@mui/material';
import {
  PlayArrow as StartIcon,
  Stop as StopIcon,
  Visibility as ViewIcon,
  Settings as ConfigIcon,
  Security as SecurityIcon,
  CheckCircle as SuccessIcon,
  Error as ErrorIcon,
  Schedule as PendingIcon
} from '@mui/icons-material';

interface Agent {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  status: 'idle' | 'running' | 'completed' | 'failed' | 'stopped';
  finding_id: string;
  finding_title: string;
  model: string;
  progress: number;
  created_at: string;
  completed_at?: string;
  remediation_plan?: any;
  execution_log?: string[];
}

const AgentTab: React.FC = () => {
  const [agents, setAgents] = useState<Agent[]>([]);
  const [selectedAgent, setSelectedAgent] = useState<Agent | null>(null);
  const [openDialog, setOpenDialog] = useState(false);
  const [openConfigDialog, setOpenConfigDialog] = useState(false);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  // Agent configuration
  const [agentConfig, setAgentConfig] = useState({
    model: 'gpt-4-1106-preview',
    max_conversation_turns: 10,
    temperature: 0.1,
    auto_execute: false,
    validation_mode: true
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchAgents();
    const interval = setInterval(fetchAgents, 5000); // Refresh every 5 seconds
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, []);

  const fetchAgents = async () => {
    try {
      const response = await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:9099/api/v1/agents');
      const data = await response.json();
      setAgents(data.agents || []);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error fetching agents:', error);
    }
  };

  const createAgent = async (findingId: string) => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const response = await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:9099/api/v1/agents', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          finding_id: findingId,
          config: agentConfig
        }),
      });

      if (response.ok) {
        const result = await response.json();
        console.log('Agent created:', result);
        await fetchAgents();
        setOpenDialog(false);
      } else {
        console.error('Failed to create agent');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error creating agent:', error);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const startAgent = async (agentId: string) => {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:9099/api/v1/agents/${agentId}/start`, {
        method: 'POST'
      });
      if (response.ok) {
        await fetchAgents();
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error starting agent:', error);
    }
  };

  const stopAgent = async (agentId: string) => {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:9099/api/v1/agents/${agentId}/stop`, {
        method: 'POST'
      });
      if (response.ok) {
        await fetchAgents();
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error stopping agent:', error);
    }
  };

  const getStatusIcon = (status: string) => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'running':
        return <LinearProgress size={20} />;
      case 'completed':
        return <SuccessIcon color="success" />;
      case 'failed':
        return <ErrorIcon color="error" />;
      case 'stopped':
        return <StopIcon color="action" />;
      default:
        return <PendingIcon color="info" />;
    }
  };

  const getStatusColor = (status: string) => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'running':
        return 'primary';
      case 'completed':
        return 'success';
      case 'failed':
        return 'error';
      case 'stopped':
        return 'default';
      default:
        return 'info';
    }
  };

  return (
    <Box sx={{ p: 3 }}>
      <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', mb: 3 }}>
        <Typography variant="h4" component="h1">
          🤖 AI Remediation Agents
        </Typography>
        <Box>
          <Button
            variant="outlined"
            startIcon={<ConfigIcon />}
            onClick={() => setOpenConfigDialog(true)}
            sx={{ mr: 2 }}
          >
            Agent Settings
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant="contained"
            startIcon={<SecurityIcon />}
            onClick={() => setOpenDialog(true)}
          >
            Create New Agent
          </Button>
        </Box>
      </Box>

      {/* Agent Statistics */}
      <Grid container spacing={3} sx={{ mb: 3 }}>
        <Grid item xs={3}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Typography color="textSecondary" gutterBottom>
                Total Agents
              </Typography>
              <Typography variant="h4">
                {agents.length}
              </Typography>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Grid>
        <Grid item xs={3}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Typography color="textSecondary" gutterBottom>
                Running
              </Typography>
              <Typography variant="h4" color="primary">
                {agents.filter(a => a.status === 'running').length}
              </Typography>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Grid>
        <Grid item xs={3}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Typography color="textSecondary" gutterBottom>
                Completed
              </Typography>
              <Typography variant="h4" color="success.main">
                {agents.filter(a => a.status === 'completed').length}
              </Typography>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Grid>
        <Grid item xs={3}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Typography color="textSecondary" gutterBottom>
                Success Rate
              </Typography>
              <Typography variant="h4" color="success.main">
                {agents.length > 0 
                  ? Math.round((agents.filter(a => a.status === 'completed').length / agents.length) * 100)
                  : 0}%
              </Typography>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Grid>
      </Grid>

      {/* Agents Table */}
      <Paper sx={{ width: '100%', overflow: 'hidden' }}>
        <TableContainer>
          <Table>
            <TableHead>
              <TableRow>
                <TableCell>Status</TableCell>
                <TableCell>Agent Name</TableCell>
                <TableCell>Finding</TableCell>
                <TableCell>Model</TableCell>
                <TableCell>Progress</TableCell>
                <TableCell>Created</TableCell>
                <TableCell>Actions</TableCell>
              </TableRow>
            </TableHead>
            <TableBody>
              {agents.map((agent) => (
                <TableRow key={agent.id}>
                  <TableCell>
                    <Chip
                      icon={getStatusIcon(agent.status)}
                      label={agent.status}
                      color={getStatusColor(agent.status) as any}
                      size="small"
                    />
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell>
                    <Typography variant="body2" fontWeight="bold">
                      {agent.name}
                    </Typography>
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell>
                    <Typography variant="body2">
                      {agent.finding_title}
                    </Typography>
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell>
                    <Chip label={agent.model} variant="outlined" size="small" />
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell>
                    <Box sx={{ width: '100%' }}>
                      <LinearProgress
                        variant="determinate"
                        value={agent.progress}
                        sx={{ mb: 1 }}
                      />
                      <Typography variant="caption">
                        {agent.progress}%
                      </Typography>
                    </Box>
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell>
                    <Typography variant="body2">
                      {new Date(agent.created_at).toLocaleString()}
                    </Typography>
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell>
                    <Tooltip title="View Details">
                      <IconButton size="small" onClick={() => setSelectedAgent(agent)}>
                        <ViewIcon />
                      </IconButton>
                    </Tooltip>
                    {agent.status === 'idle' && (
                      <Tooltip title="Start Agent">
                        <IconButton size="small" onClick={() => startAgent(agent.id)}>
                          <StartIcon />
                        </IconButton>
                      </Tooltip>
                    )}
                    {agent.status === 'running' && (
                      <Tooltip title="Stop Agent">
                        <IconButton size="small" onClick={() => stopAgent(agent.id)}>
                          <StopIcon />
                        </IconButton>
                      </Tooltip>
                    )}
                  </TableCell>
                </TableRow>
              ))}
            </TableBody>
          </Table>
        </TableContainer>
      </Paper>

      {/* Agent Configuration Dialog */}
      <Dialog open={openConfigDialog} onClose={() => setOpenConfigDialog(false)} maxWidth="md" fullWidth>
        <DialogTitle>Agent Configuration</DialogTitle>
        <DialogContent>
          <Grid container spacing={3} sx={{ pt: 2 }}>
            <Grid item xs={6}>
              <FormControl fullWidth>
                <InputLabel>AI Model</InputLabel>
                <Select
                  value={agentConfig.model}
                  label="AI Model"
                  onChange={(e) => setAgentConfig({ ...agentConfig, model: e.target.value })}
                >
                  <MenuItem value="gpt-4-1106-preview">GPT-4 Turbo (Recommended)</MenuItem>
                  <MenuItem value="gpt-4o">GPT-4o</MenuItem>
                  <MenuItem value="claude-3-opus-20240229">Claude-3 Opus</MenuItem>
                  <MenuItem value="gpt-3.5-turbo">GPT-3.5 Turbo</MenuItem>
                </Select>
              </FormControl>
            </Grid>
            <Grid item xs={6}>
              <TextField
                fullWidth
                label="Max Conversation Turns"
                type="number"
                value={agentConfig.max_conversation_turns}
                onChange={(e) => setAgentConfig({ ...agentConfig, max_conversation_turns: parseInt(e.target.value) })}
                inputProps={{ min: 1, max: 20 }}
              />
            </Grid>
            <Grid item xs={6}>
              <TextField
                fullWidth
                label="Temperature"
                type="number"
                value={agentConfig.temperature}
                onChange={(e) => setAgentConfig({ ...agentConfig, temperature: parseFloat(e.target.value) })}
                inputProps={{ min: 0, max: 1, step: 0.1 }}
                helperText="Lower = more consistent, Higher = more creative"
              />
            </Grid>
            <Grid item xs={6}>
              <FormControl fullWidth>
                <InputLabel>Validation Mode</InputLabel>
                <Select
                  value={agentConfig.validation_mode ? 'true' : 'false'}
                  label="Validation Mode"
                  onChange={(e) => setAgentConfig({ ...agentConfig, validation_mode: e.target.value === 'true' })}
                >
                  <MenuItem value="true">Enabled (Recommended)</MenuItem>
                  <MenuItem value="false">Disabled</MenuItem>
                </Select>
              </FormControl>
            </Grid>
          </Grid>
        </DialogContent>
        <DialogActions>
          <Button onClick={() => setOpenConfigDialog(false)}>Cancel</Button>
          <Button onClick={() => setOpenConfigDialog(false)} variant="contained">
            Save Configuration
          </Button>
        </DialogActions>
      </Dialog>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default AgentTab;

@app.get("/api/v1/agents")
async def get_agents():

        "statistics": {

            "completed": len([a for a in AGENT_DATA if a["status"] == "completed"]),
            "failed": len([a for a in AGENT_DATA if a["status"] == "failed"])
        }
    }

@app.post("/api/v1/agents")
async def create_agent(agent_request: dict):
    """Create a new AI remediation agent"""
    try:
        finding_id = agent_request.get("finding_id")
        config = agent_request.get("config", {})
        
        if not finding_id:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="finding_id is required")
        
        # Find the finding data
        finding = None
        for scan in SECURITY_SCANS:
            for f in scan.get("findings", []):
                if f.get("id") == finding_id:
                    finding = f
                    break
            if finding:
                break
        
        if not finding:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Finding not found")
        
        # Create agent
        agent_id = f"agent-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
        agent = {
            "id": agent_id,
            "name": f"Remediation Agent for {finding.get('title', 'Security Finding')}",
            "status": "idle",
            "finding_id": finding_id,
            "finding_title": finding.get("title", "Security Finding"),
            "model": config.get("model", "gpt-4-1106-preview"),
            "progress": 0,
            "created_at": datetime.now().isoformat(),
            "config": config,
            "remediation_plan": None,
            "execution_log": []
        }
        
        AGENT_DATA.append(agent)
        
        return {
            "agent": agent,
            "message": "Agent created successfully"
        }
        
    except Exception as e:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=f"Failed to create agent: {str(e)}")

@app.post("/api/v1/agents/{agent_id}/start")
async def start_agent(agent_id: str):
    """Start an AI remediation agent"""
    try:
        agent = next((a for a in AGENT_DATA if a["id"] == agent_id), None)
        if not agent:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Agent not found")
        
        if agent["status"] != "idle":
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Agent is not in idle state")
        
        # Start the agent execution
        agent["status"] = "running"
        agent["progress"] = 0
        
        # Start async agent execution
        asyncio.create_task(_execute_agent_background(agent_id))
        
        return {"message": f"Agent {agent_id} started successfully"}
        
    except Exception as e:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=f"Failed to start agent: {str(e)}")

@app.post("/api/v1/agents/{agent_id}/stop")
async def stop_agent(agent_id: str):
    """Stop an AI remediation agent"""
    try:
        agent = next((a for a in AGENT_DATA if a["id"] == agent_id), None)
        if not agent:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Agent not found")
        
        if agent["status"] != "running":
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Agent is not running")
        
        agent["status"] = "stopped"
        agent["progress"] = 0
        
        return {"message": f"Agent {agent_id} stopped successfully"}
        
    except Exception as e:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=f"Failed to stop agent: {str(e)}")

async def _execute_agent_background(agent_id: str):
    """Execute agent in background"""
    try:
        agent = next((a for a in AGENT_DATA if a["id"] == agent_id), None)
        if not agent:
            return
        
        # Simulate agent execution
        total_steps = 5
        for i in range(total_steps):
            await asyncio.sleep(2)  # Simulate processing time
            
            # Update progress
            progress = int((i + 1) / total_steps * 100)
            agent["progress"] = progress
            
            # Add execution log
            agent["execution_log"].append(f"Step {i + 1}: Processing remediation plan...")
        
        # Complete agent execution
        agent["status"] = "completed"
        agent["completed_at"] = datetime.now().isoformat()
        
        # Generate remediation plan
        agent["remediation_plan"] = {
            "analysis": {
                "current_state": "Security configuration analysis completed",
                "root_cause": "Identified security misconfiguration",
                "risk_assessment": "Medium risk - requires immediate attention"
            },
            "remediation_steps": [
                {
                    "step_number": 1,
                    "action": "Enable security feature",
                    "command": "az security feature enable --name SecurityFeature",
                    "validation": "az security feature show --name SecurityFeature",
                    "estimated_time": "5 minutes",
                    "prerequisites": ["Contributor permissions"]
                }
            ],
            "validation_commands": [
                "az security assessment list",
                "az security recommendation list"
            ],
            "documentation": {
                "changes_made": "Security features enabled",
                "compliance_status": "Compliant",
                "recommendations": ["Regular security reviews", "Monitor security alerts"]
            }
        }
        
        print(f"✅ Agent {agent_id} completed successfully")
        
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ Agent {agent_id} failed: {e}")
        agent = next((a for a in AGENT_DATA if a["id"] == agent_id), None)
        if agent:
            agent["status"] = "failed"
            agent["completed_at"] = datetime.now().isoformat()

# Initialize agent data
AGENT_DATA = []

def generate_agent_prompt(finding_data: dict) -> str:
    """Generate comprehensive prompt for the remediation agent"""
    
    finding_title = finding_data.get('title', 'Security Finding')
    severity = finding_data.get('severity', 'medium')
    description = finding_data.get('description', '')
    resource_type = finding_data.get('resource_type', 'unknown')
    
    prompt = f"""
You are an expert Azure Security Remediation Agent specialized in CIS (Center for Internet Security) compliance.

## MISSION
Remediate the following security finding: "{finding_title}"

## CONTEXT
- **Finding**: {finding_title}
- **Severity**: {severity.upper()}
- **Description**: {description}
- **Resource Type**: {resource_type}
- **CIS Control**: {finding_data.get('cis_control', 'N/A')}

## YOUR CAPABILITIES
1. **Azure Resource Analysis**: Analyze current Azure configuration
2. **Security Assessment**: Evaluate security posture
3. **Remediation Planning**: Create step-by-step remediation plans
4. **Code Generation**: Generate Azure CLI and PowerShell commands
5. **Validation**: Verify remediation effectiveness
6. **Documentation**: Create detailed remediation reports

## REMEDIATION PROCESS
Follow this structured approach:

### Phase 1: Analysis
1. Analyze the current Azure configuration related to this finding
2. Identify the root cause of the security issue
3. Assess the business impact and risk level

### Phase 2: Planning
1. Create a detailed remediation plan with specific steps
2. Identify required permissions and prerequisites
3. Plan for rollback procedures if needed
4. Estimate time and effort required

### Phase 3: Implementation
1. Generate specific Azure CLI and PowerShell commands
2. Provide step-by-step execution instructions
3. Include validation commands to verify changes
4. Add error handling and troubleshooting steps

### Phase 4: Validation
1. Verify that the remediation was successful
2. Run security checks to confirm compliance
3. Document the changes made
4. Provide post-remediation recommendations

## SECURITY PRINCIPLES
- Follow the principle of least privilege
- Implement defense in depth
- Ensure audit logging is enabled
- Maintain compliance with CIS benchmarks
- Consider business continuity during remediation

## OUTPUT FORMAT
Provide your response in this structured JSON format:
{{
    "analysis": {{
        "current_state": "Description of current configuration",
        "root_cause": "What's causing the security issue",
        "risk_assessment": "Business impact and risk level"
    }},
    "remediation_plan": {{
        "steps": [
            {{
                "step_number": 1,
                "action": "Specific action to take",
                "command": "Azure CLI or PowerShell command",
                "validation": "Command to verify the change",
                "estimated_time": "Time estimate",
                "prerequisites": ["Required permissions", "Prerequisites"]
            }}
        ],
        "rollback_plan": "How to rollback if needed",
        "total_estimated_time": "Total time estimate"
    }},
    "validation_commands": [
        "Command to verify remediation",
        "Additional validation steps"
    ],
    "documentation": {{
        "changes_made": "Summary of changes",
        "compliance_status": "CIS compliance status after remediation",
        "recommendations": ["Additional security recommendations"]
    }}
}}

## IMPORTANT NOTES
- Always prioritize security over convenience
- Provide specific, actionable commands
- Include validation steps for each action
- Consider the impact on existing services
- Follow Azure security best practices
- Document all changes for audit purposes

Begin your analysis and provide a comprehensive remediation plan.
"""
    
    return prompt

@app.delete("/api/v1/agents/{agent_id}")
async def delete_agent(agent_id: str):
    """Delete an agent"""
    global AGENT_DATA
    agent = next((a for a in AGENT_DATA if a["id"] == agent_id), None)
    if not agent:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Agent not found")
    
    if agent["status"] == "running":
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Cannot delete running agent")
    
    AGENT_DATA = [a for a in AGENT_DATA if a["id"] != agent_id]
    
    print(f"🗑️ Deleted agent: {agent_id}")
    
    return {"message": f"Agent {agent_id} deleted successfully"}

async def _execute_agent_background(agent_id: str):
    """Execute agent in background"""
    try:
        agent = next((a for a in AGENT_DATA if a["id"] == agent_id), None)
        if not agent:
            return
        
        # Simulate agent execution with realistic steps
        execution_steps = [
            "Analyzing Azure resource configuration...",
            "Identifying security vulnerabilities...",
            "Generating remediation plan...",
            "Creating Azure CLI commands...",
            "Preparing validation steps...",
            "Finalizing documentation..."
        ]
        
        total_steps = len(execution_steps)
        for i, step in enumerate(execution_steps):
            await asyncio.sleep(3)  # Simulate processing time
            
            # Update progress
            progress = int((i + 1) / total_steps * 100)
            agent["progress"] = progress
            
            # Add execution log
            agent["execution_log"].append(f"Step {i + 1}: {step}")
            
            # Check if agent was stopped
            if agent["status"] == "stopped":
                return
        
        # Complete agent execution
        agent["status"] = "completed"
        agent["completed_at"] = datetime.now().isoformat()
        
        # Generate comprehensive remediation plan
        agent["remediation_plan"] = {
            "analysis": {
                "current_state": f"Security configuration analysis completed for {agent['finding_title']}",
                "root_cause": "Identified security misconfiguration requiring immediate attention",
                "risk_assessment": f"{agent['severity'].title()} risk - requires immediate remediation"
            },
            "remediation_plan": {

def generate_agent_prompt(finding_data: dict) -> str:
    """Generate comprehensive prompt for the remediation agent"""
    
    finding_title = finding_data.get('title', 'Security Finding')
    severity = finding_data.get('severity', 'medium')
    description = finding_data.get('description', '')
    resource_type = finding_data.get('resource_type', 'unknown')
    
    prompt = f"""
You are an expert Azure Security Remediation Agent specialized in CIS (Center for Internet Security) compliance.

## MISSION
Remediate the following security finding: "{finding_title}"

## CONTEXT
- **Finding**: {finding_title}
- **Severity**: {severity.upper()}
- **Description**: {description}
- **Resource Type**: {resource_type}
- **CIS Control**: {finding_data.get('cis_control', 'N/A')}

## YOUR CAPABILITIES
1. **Azure Resource Analysis**: Analyze current Azure configuration
2. **Security Assessment**: Evaluate security posture
3. **Remediation Planning**: Create step-by-step remediation plans
4. **Code Generation**: Generate Azure CLI and PowerShell commands
5. **Validation**: Verify remediation effectiveness
6. **Documentation**: Create detailed remediation reports

## REMEDIATION PROCESS
Follow this structured approach:

### Phase 1: Analysis
1. Analyze the current Azure configuration related to this finding
2. Identify the root cause of the security issue
3. Assess the business impact and risk level

### Phase 2: Planning
1. Create a detailed remediation plan with specific steps
2. Identify required permissions and prerequisites
3. Plan for rollback procedures if needed
4. Estimate time and effort required

### Phase 3: Implementation
1. Generate specific Azure CLI and PowerShell commands
2. Provide step-by-step execution instructions
3. Include validation commands to verify changes
4. Add error handling and troubleshooting steps

### Phase 4: Validation
1. Verify that the remediation was successful
2. Run security checks to confirm compliance
3. Document the changes made
4. Provide post-remediation recommendations

## SECURITY PRINCIPLES
- Follow the principle of least privilege
- Implement defense in depth
- Ensure audit logging is enabled
- Maintain compliance with CIS benchmarks
- Consider business continuity during remediation

## OUTPUT FORMAT
Provide your response in this structured JSON format:
{{
    "analysis": {{
        "current_state": "Description of current configuration",
        "root_cause": "What's causing the security issue",
        "risk_assessment": "Business impact and risk level"
    }},
    "remediation_plan": {{
        "steps": [
            {{
                "step_number": 1,
                "action": "Specific action to take",
                "command": "Azure CLI or PowerShell command",
                "validation": "Command to verify the change",
                "estimated_time": "Time estimate",
                "prerequisites": ["Required permissions", "Prerequisites"]
            }}
        ],
        "rollback_plan": "How to rollback if needed",
        "total_estimated_time": "Total time estimate"
    }},
    "validation_commands": [
        "Command to verify remediation",
        "Additional validation steps"
    ],
    "documentation": {{
        "changes_made": "Summary of changes",
        "compliance_status": "CIS compliance status after remediation",
        "recommendations": ["Additional security recommendations"]
    }}
}}

## IMPORTANT NOTES
- Always prioritize security over convenience
- Provide specific, actionable commands
- Include validation steps for each action
- Consider the impact on existing services
- Follow Azure security best practices
- Document all changes for audit purposes

Begin your analysis and provide a comprehensive remediation plan.
"""
    
    return prompt

async def create_agent(agent_request: dict):
    """Create a new AI remediation agent"""
    try:
        finding_id = agent_request.get("finding_id")
        config = agent_request.get("config", {})
        
        if not finding_id:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="finding_id is required")
        
        # Find the finding data from existing scans
        finding = None
        for scan in SECURITY_SCANS:
            for f in scan.get("findings", []):
                if f.get("id") == finding_id:
                    finding = f
                    break
            if finding:
                break
        
        if not finding:
            # Create a mock finding if not found
            finding = {
                "id": finding_id,
                "title": agent_request.get("finding_title", "Security Finding"),
                "description": agent_request.get("finding_description", "Security configuration issue"),
                "severity": agent_request.get("severity", "medium"),
                "resource_type": agent_request.get("resource_type", "unknown")
            }
        
        # Create agent
        agent_id = f"agent-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
        agent = {
            "id": agent_id,
            "name": f"Remediation Agent for {finding.get('title', 'Security Finding')}",
            "status": "idle",
            "finding_id": finding_id,
            "finding_title": finding.get("title", "Security Finding"),
            "finding_description": finding.get("description", ""),
            "severity": finding.get("severity", "medium"),
            "model": config.get("model", "gpt-4-1106-preview"),
            "progress": 0,
            "created_at": datetime.now().isoformat(),
            "config": config,
            "remediation_plan": None,
            "execution_log": [],
            "agent_prompt": generate_agent_prompt(finding)
        }
        
        AGENT_DATA.append(agent)
        
        print(f"🤖 Created agent: {agent_id} for finding: {finding.get('title')}")
        
        return {
            "agent": agent,
            "message": "Agent created successfully"
        }
        
    except Exception as e:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=f"Failed to create agent: {str(e)}")

@app.post("/api/v1/agents/{agent_id}/start")
async def start_agent(agent_id: str):
    """Start an AI remediation agent"""
    try:
        agent = next((a for a in AGENT_DATA if a["id"] == agent_id), None)
        if not agent:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Agent not found")
        
        if agent["status"] != "idle":
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Agent is not in idle state")
        
        # Start the agent execution
        agent["status"] = "running"
        agent["progress"] = 0
        agent["started_at"] = datetime.now().isoformat()
        
        # Start async agent execution
        asyncio.create_task(_execute_agent_background(agent_id))
        
        print(f"🚀 Started agent: {agent_id}")
        
        return {"message": f"Agent {agent_id} started successfully"}
        
    except Exception as e:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=f"Failed to start agent: {str(e)}")

@app.post("/api/v1/agents/{agent_id}/stop")
async def stop_agent(agent_id: str):
    """Stop an AI remediation agent"""
    try:
        agent = next((a for a in AGENT_DATA if a["id"] == agent_id), None)
        if not agent:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Agent not found")
        
        if agent["status"] != "running":
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Agent is not running")
        
        agent["status"] = "stopped"
        agent["progress"] = 0
        agent["stopped_at"] = datetime.now().isoformat()
        
        print(f"⏹️ Stopped agent: {agent_id}")
        
        return {"message": f"Agent {agent_id} stopped successfully"}
        
    except Exception as e:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=f"Failed to stop agent: {str(e)}")

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  Box,
  Typography,
  Paper,
  Button,
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableContainer,
  TableHead,
  TableRow,
  Chip,

  DialogActions,
  TextField,
  FormControl,
  InputLabel,
  Select,
  MenuItem,
  LinearProgress,
  Alert,
  Card,
  CardContent,
  Grid,
  Tooltip,
  Accordion,
  AccordionSummary,
  AccordionDetails,
  List,
  ListItem,
  ListItemText,
  ListItemIcon,
  Divider,
  Badge,
  Switch,
  FormControlLabel,
  FormGroup
} from '@mui/material';
import {
  PlayArrow as StartIcon,
  Stop as StopIcon,
  Visibility as ViewIcon,
  Settings as ConfigIcon,
  Security as SecurityIcon,
  CheckCircle as SuccessIcon,
  Error as ErrorIcon,
  Schedule as PendingIcon,
  Delete as DeleteIcon,
  ExpandMore as ExpandMoreIcon,
  SmartToy as AgentIcon,
  Psychology as AIIcon,
  Code as CodeIcon,
  Assessment as AssessmentIcon,
  Timeline as TimelineIcon,
  Warning as WarningIcon,
  Info as InfoIcon
} from '@mui/icons-material';

interface Agent {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  status: 'idle' | 'running' | 'completed' | 'failed' | 'stopped';
  finding_id: string;
  finding_title: string;
  finding_description: string;
  severity: string;
  model: string;
  progress: number;
  created_at: string;
  started_at?: string;
  completed_at?: string;
  config: any;
  remediation_plan?: any;
  execution_log: string[];
  agent_prompt?: string;
}

interface AgentModel {
  name: string;
  description: string;
  max_tokens: number;
  temperature: number;
}

interface AgentStatistics {
  running: number;
  completed: number;
  failed: number;
  idle: number;
}

const AgenticPage: React.FC = () => {
  const [agents, setAgents] = useState<Agent[]>([]);
  const [selectedAgent, setSelectedAgent] = useState<Agent | null>(null);
  const [openDialog, setOpenDialog] = useState(false);
  const [openConfigDialog, setOpenConfigDialog] = useState(false);
  const [openDetailsDialog, setOpenDetailsDialog] = useState(false);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [statistics, setStatistics] = useState<AgentStatistics>({ running: 0, completed: 0, failed: 0, idle: 0 });
  const [availableModels, setAvailableModels] = useState<Record<string, AgentModel>>({});

  // Agent configuration
  const [agentConfig, setAgentConfig] = useState({
    model: 'gpt-4-1106-preview',
    max_conversation_turns: 10,
    temperature: 0.1,
    auto_execute: false,
    validation_mode: true,
    enable_logging: true
  });

  // New agent form
  const [newAgent, setNewAgent] = useState({
    finding_title: '',
    finding_description: '',
    severity: 'medium',
    resource_type: 'unknown'
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchAgents();
    fetchAgentModels();
    const interval = setInterval(fetchAgents, 5000); // Refresh every 5 seconds
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, []);

  const fetchAgents = async () => {
    try {
      const response = await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:9099/api/v1/agents');
      const data = await response.json();
      setAgents(data.agents || []);
      setStatistics(data.statistics || { running: 0, completed: 0, failed: 0, idle: 0 });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error fetching agents:', error);
    }
  };

  const fetchAgentModels = async () => {
    try {
      const response = await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:9099/api/v1/agents/models');
      const data = await response.json();
      setAvailableModels(data.models || {});
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error fetching agent models:', error);
    }
  };

  const createAgent = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const response = await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:9099/api/v1/agents', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          finding_id: `finding-${Date.now()}`,
          finding_title: newAgent.finding_title,
          finding_description: newAgent.finding_description,
          severity: newAgent.severity,
          resource_type: newAgent.resource_type,
          config: agentConfig
        }),
      });

      if (response.ok) {
        const result = await response.json();
        console.log('Agent created:', result);
        await fetchAgents();
        setOpenDialog(false);
        resetNewAgentForm();
      } else {
        console.error('Failed to create agent');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error creating agent:', error);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const resetNewAgentForm = () => {
    setNewAgent({
      finding_title: '',
      finding_description: '',
      severity: 'medium',
      resource_type: 'unknown'
    });
  };

  const startAgent = async (agentId: string) => {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:9099/api/v1/agents/${agentId}/start`, {
        method: 'POST'
      });
      if (response.ok) {
        await fetchAgents();
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error starting agent:', error);
    }
  };

  const stopAgent = async (agentId: string) => {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:9099/api/v1/agents/${agentId}/stop`, {
        method: 'POST'
      });
      if (response.ok) {
        await fetchAgents();
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error stopping agent:', error);
    }
  };

  const deleteAgent = async (agentId: string) => {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:9099/api/v1/agents/${agentId}`, {
        method: 'DELETE'
      });
      if (response.ok) {
        await fetchAgents();
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error deleting agent:', error);
    }
  };

  const getStatusIcon = (status: string) => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'running':
        return <LinearProgress size={20} />;
      case 'completed':
        return <SuccessIcon color="success" />;
      case 'failed':
        return <ErrorIcon color="error" />;
      case 'stopped':
        return <StopIcon color="action" />;
      default:
        return <PendingIcon color="info" />;
    }
  };

  const getStatusColor = (status: string) => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'running':
        return 'primary';
      case 'completed':
        return 'success';
      case 'failed':
        return 'error';
      case 'stopped':
        return 'default';
      default:
        return 'info';
    }
  };

  const getSeverityColor = (severity: string) => {
    switch (severity.toLowerCase()) {
      case 'critical':
        return 'error';
      case 'high':
        return 'warning';
      case 'medium':
        return 'info';
      case 'low':
        return 'success';
      default:
        return 'default';
    }
  };

  const formatDuration = (startTime: string, endTime?: string) => {
    if (!startTime) return 'N/A';
    
    const start = new Date(startTime);
    const end = endTime ? new Date(endTime) : new Date();
    const diff = end.getTime() - start.getTime();
    
    const minutes = Math.floor(diff / 60000);
    const seconds = Math.floor((diff % 60000) / 1000);
    
    if (minutes > 0) {
      return `${minutes}m ${seconds}s`;
    }
    return `${seconds}s`;
  };

  return (
    <Box sx={{ p: 3 }}>
      <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', mb: 3 }}>
        <Box>
          <Typography variant="h4" component="h1" sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
            <AgentIcon color="primary" />
            Agentic - AI Remediation Agents
          </Typography>
          <Typography variant="body1" color="text.secondary" sx={{ mt: 1 }}>
            Intelligent AI agents for automated security remediation and compliance
          </Typography>
        </Box>
        <Box>
          <Button
            variant="outlined"
            startIcon={<ConfigIcon />}
            onClick={() => setOpenConfigDialog(true)}
            sx={{ mr: 2 }}
          >
            Agent Settings
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant="contained"
            startIcon={<SecurityIcon />}
            onClick={() => setOpenDialog(true)}
          >
            Create New Agent
          </Button>
        </Box>
      </Box>

      {/* Agent Statistics */}
      <Grid container spacing={3} sx={{ mb: 3 }}>
        <Grid item xs={3}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Typography color="textSecondary" gutterBottom>
                Total Agents
              </Typography>
              <Typography variant="h4">
                {agents.length}
              </Typography>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Grid>
        <Grid item xs={3}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Typography color="textSecondary" gutterBottom>
                Running
              </Typography>
              <Typography variant="h4" color="primary">
                {statistics.running}
              </Typography>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Grid>
        <Grid item xs={3}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Typography color="textSecondary" gutterBottom>
                Completed
              </Typography>
              <Typography variant="h4" color="success.main">
                {statistics.completed}
              </Typography>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Grid>
        <Grid item xs={3}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Typography color="textSecondary" gutterBottom>
                Success Rate
              </Typography>
              <Typography variant="h4" color="success.main">
                {agents.length > 0 
                  ? Math.round((statistics.completed / agents.length) * 100)
                  : 0}%
              </Typography>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Grid>
      </Grid>

      {/* Agents Table */}
      <Paper sx={{ width: '100%', overflow: 'hidden' }}>
        <TableContainer>
          <Table>
            <TableHead>
              <TableRow>
                <TableCell>Status</TableCell>
                <TableCell>Agent Name</TableCell>
                <TableCell>Finding</TableCell>
                <TableCell>Severity</TableCell>
                <TableCell>Model</TableCell>
                <TableCell>Progress</TableCell>
                <TableCell>Duration</TableCell>
                <TableCell>Actions</TableCell>
              </TableRow>
            </TableHead>
            <TableBody>
              {agents.map((agent) => (
                <TableRow key={agent.id}>
                  <TableCell>
                    <Chip
                      icon={getStatusIcon(agent.status)}
                      label={agent.status}
                      color={getStatusColor(agent.status) as any}
                      size="small"
                    />
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell>
                    <Typography variant="body2" fontWeight="bold">
                      {agent.name}
                    </Typography>
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell>
                    <Typography variant="body2">
                      {agent.finding_title}
                    </Typography>
                    <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
                      {agent.finding_description.substring(0, 50)}...
                    </Typography>
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell>
                    <Chip 
                      label={agent.severity} 
                      color={getSeverityColor(agent.severity) as any}
                      size="small"
                    />
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell>
                    <Chip label={agent.model} variant="outlined" size="small" />
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell>
                    <Box sx={{ width: '100%' }}>
                      <LinearProgress
                        variant="determinate"

                        sx={{ mb: 1 }}
                      />
                      <Typography variant="caption">
                        {agent.progress}%
                      </Typography>
                    </Box>
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell>
                    <Typography variant="body2">
                      {formatDuration(agent.started_at || agent.created_at, agent.completed_at)}
                    </Typography>
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell>
                    <Tooltip title="View Details">
                      <IconButton size="small" onClick={() => { setSelectedAgent(agent); setOpenDetailsDialog(true); }}>
                        <ViewIcon />

                    </Tooltip>
                    {agent.status === 'idle' && (

                        <IconButton size="small" onClick={() => startAgent(agent.id)}>
                          <StartIcon />

                    {agent.status === 'running' && (

                    {agent.status !== 'running' && (

              {agents.length === 0 && (

      <Dialog open={openDialog} onClose={() => setOpenDialog(false)} maxWidth="md" fullWidth>

                      <Box>
                        <Typography variant="body2">{model.name}</Typography>
                        <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
                          {model.description}

            <Grid item xs={6}>

            </Grid>
            <Grid item xs={12}>

            <Grid item xs={6}>

                  value={agentConfig.validation_mode ? 'true' : 'false'}
                  label="Validation Mode"

                  <MenuItem value="true">Enabled (Recommended)</MenuItem>

            <Grid item xs={12}>

        <DialogActions>
          <Button onClick={() => setOpenConfigDialog(false)}>Cancel</Button>

      <Dialog open={openDetailsDialog} onClose={() => setOpenDetailsDialog(false)} maxWidth="lg" fullWidth>

                <Card>
                  <CardContent>

                        <Typography variant="body2">{selectedAgent.model}</Typography>
                      </Grid>

              {selectedAgent.execution_log.length > 0 && (

                          <ListItem key={index}>
                            <ListItemIcon>
                              <InfoIcon color="info" />
                            </ListItemIcon>
                            <ListItemText primary={log} />
                          </ListItem>
                        ))}
                      </List>
                    </CardContent>
                  </Card>
                </Grid>
              )}

              {selectedAgent.remediation_plan && (
                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <Card>

                      <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>Remediation Plan</Typography>
                      <Accordion>

                          <Typography variant="subtitle1">Analysis</Typography>
                        </AccordionSummary>
                        <AccordionDetails>
                          <Typography variant="body2" paragraph>
                            <strong>Current State:</strong> {selectedAgent.remediation_plan.analysis.current_state}
                          </Typography>
                          <Typography variant="body2" paragraph>
                            <strong>Root Cause:</strong> {selectedAgent.remediation_plan.analysis.root_cause}
                          </Typography>
                          <Typography variant="body2">
                            <strong>Risk Assessment:</strong> {selectedAgent.remediation_plan.analysis.risk_assessment}
                          </Typography>
                        </AccordionDetails>
                      </Accordion>

                      <Accordion>
                        <AccordionSummary expandIcon={<ExpandMoreIcon />}>
                          <Typography variant="subtitle1">Remediation Steps</Typography>
                        </AccordionSummary>
                        <AccordionDetails>
                          {selectedAgent.remediation_plan.remediation_plan.steps.map((step: any, index: number) => (
                            <Box key={index} sx={{ mb: 2, p: 2, border: '1px solid #e0e0e0', borderRadius: 1 }}>
                              <Typography variant="subtitle2" gutterBottom>
                                Step {step.step_number}: {step.action}
                              </Typography>
                              <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" paragraph>
                                <strong>Command:</strong> {step.command}
                              </Typography>
                              <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" paragraph>
                                <strong>Validation:</strong> {step.validation}
                              </Typography>
                              <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                                <strong>Estimated Time:</strong> {step.estimated_time}
                              </Typography>
                            </Box>
                          ))}
                        </AccordionDetails>
                      </Accordion>

                      <Accordion>
                        <AccordionSummary expandIcon={<ExpandMoreIcon />}>
                          <Typography variant="subtitle1">Documentation</Typography>
                        </AccordionSummary>
                        <AccordionDetails>
                          <Typography variant="body2" paragraph>
                            <strong>Changes Made:</strong> {selectedAgent.remediation_plan.documentation.changes_made}
                          </Typography>
                          <Typography variant="body2" paragraph>
                            <strong>Compliance Status:</strong> {selectedAgent.remediation_plan.documentation.compliance_status}
                          </Typography>
                          <Typography variant="body2">
                            <strong>Recommendations:</strong>
                          </Typography>
                          <List dense>
                            {selectedAgent.remediation_plan.documentation.recommendations.map((rec: string, index: number) => (
                              <ListItem key={index}>
                                <ListItemIcon>
                                  <InfoIcon color="info" />
                                </ListItemIcon>
                                <ListItemText primary={rec} />
                              </ListItem>
                            ))}
                          </List>
                        </AccordionDetails>
                      </Accordion>
                    </CardContent>
                  </Card>
                </Grid>
              )}
            </Grid>
          )}
        </DialogContent>
        <DialogActions>
          <Button onClick={() => setOpenDetailsDialog(false)}>Close</Button>
        </DialogActions>
      </Dialog>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default AgenticPage;

const AgenticPage: React.FC = () => {
  const [agents, setAgents] = useState<Agent[]>([]);
  const [selectedAgent, setSelectedAgent] = useState<Agent | null>(null);
  const [openDialog, setOpenDialog] = useState(false);
  const [openConfigDialog, setOpenConfigDialog] = useState(false);
  const [openDetailsDialog, setOpenDetailsDialog] = useState(false);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [statistics, setStatistics] = useState<AgentStatistics>({ running: 0, completed: 0, failed: 0, idle: 0 });
  const [availableModels, setAvailableModels] = useState<Record<string, AgentModel>>({});

  // Agent configuration
  const [agentConfig, setAgentConfig] = useState({
    model: 'gpt-4-1106-preview',
    max_conversation_turns: 10,
    temperature: 0.1,
    auto_execute: false,
    validation_mode: true,
    enable_logging: true
  });

  // New agent form

    finding_title: '',
    finding_description: '',

  });

    fetchAgentModels();
    const interval = setInterval(fetchAgents, 5000); // Refresh every 5 seconds
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, []);

  const fetchAgents = async () => {
    try {
      const response = await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:9099/api/v1/agents');
      const data = await response.json();
      setAgents(data.agents || []);
      setStatistics(data.statistics || { running: 0, completed: 0, failed: 0, idle: 0 });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error fetching agents:', error);

  const fetchAgentModels = async () => {

      const response = await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:9099/api/v1/agents/models');

    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error fetching agent models:', error);
    }
  };

  const createAgent = async () => {
    try {
