        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          finding_id: `finding-${Date.now()}`,
          finding_title: newAgent.finding_title,
          finding_description: newAgent.finding_description,
          severity: newAgent.severity,
          resource_type: newAgent.resource_type,
          config: agentConfig
        }),
      });

      if (response.ok) {
        const result = await response.json();
        console.log('Agent created:', result);
        await fetchAgents();
        setOpenDialog(false);
        resetNewAgentForm();
      } else {
        console.error('Failed to create agent');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error creating agent:', error);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const resetNewAgentForm = () => {
    setNewAgent({
      finding_title: '',
      finding_description: '',
      severity: 'medium',
      resource_type: 'unknown'
    });
  };

  const startAgent = async (agentId: string) => {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:9099/api/v1/agents/${agentId}/start`, {
        method: 'POST'
      });
      if (response.ok) {
        await fetchAgents();
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error starting agent:', error);
    }
  };

  const stopAgent = async (agentId: string) => {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:9099/api/v1/agents/${agentId}/stop`, {
        method: 'POST'
      });
      if (response.ok) {
        await fetchAgents();
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error stopping agent:', error);
    }
  };

  const deleteAgent = async (agentId: string) => {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:9099/api/v1/agents/${agentId}`, {
        method: 'DELETE'
      });
      if (response.ok) {
        await fetchAgents();
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error deleting agent:', error);
    }
  };

  const getStatusIcon = (status: string) => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'running':
        return <LinearProgress size={20} />;
      case 'completed':
        return <SuccessIcon color="success" />;
      case 'failed':
        return <ErrorIcon color="error" />;
      case 'stopped':
        return <StopIcon color="action" />;
      default:
        return <PendingIcon color="info" />;
    }
  };

  const getStatusColor = (status: string) => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'running':
        return 'primary';
      case 'completed':
        return 'success';
      case 'failed':
        return 'error';
      case 'stopped':
        return 'default';
      default:
        return 'info';
    }
  };

  const getSeverityColor = (severity: string) => {
    switch (severity.toLowerCase()) {
      case 'critical':
        return 'error';
      case 'high':
        return 'warning';
      case 'medium':
        return 'info';
      case 'low':
        return 'success';
      default:
        return 'default';
    }
  };

  const formatDuration = (startTime: string, endTime?: string) => {
    if (!startTime) return 'N/A';
    
    const start = new Date(startTime);
    const end = endTime ? new Date(endTime) : new Date();
    const diff = end.getTime() - start.getTime();
    
    const minutes = Math.floor(diff / 60000);
    const seconds = Math.floor((diff % 60000) / 1000);
    
    if (minutes > 0) {
      return `${minutes}m ${seconds}s`;
    }
    return `${seconds}s`;
  };

  return (
    <Box sx={{ p: 3 }}>
      <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', mb: 3 }}>
        <Box>
          <Typography variant="h4" component="h1" sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
            <AgentIcon color="primary" />
            Agentic - AI Remediation Agents
          </Typography>
          <Typography variant="body1" color="text.secondary" sx={{ mt: 1 }}>
            Intelligent AI agents for automated security remediation and compliance
          </Typography>
        </Box>
        <Box>
          <Button
            variant="outlined"
            startIcon={<ConfigIcon />}
            onClick={() => setOpenConfigDialog(true)}
            sx={{ mr: 2 }}
          >
            Agent Settings
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant="contained"
            startIcon={<SecurityIcon />}
            onClick={() => setOpenDialog(true)}
          >
            Create New Agent
          </Button>
        </Box>
      </Box>

      {/* Agent Statistics */}
      <Grid container spacing={3} sx={{ mb: 3 }}>
        <Grid item xs={3}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Typography color="textSecondary" gutterBottom>
                Total Agents
              </Typography>
              <Typography variant="h4">
                {agents.length}
              </Typography>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Grid>
        <Grid item xs={3}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Typography color="textSecondary" gutterBottom>
                Running
              </Typography>
              <Typography variant="h4" color="primary">
                {statistics.running}
              </Typography>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Grid>
        <Grid item xs={3}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Typography color="textSecondary" gutterBottom>
                Completed
              </Typography>
              <Typography variant="h4" color="success.main">
                {statistics.completed}
              </Typography>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Grid>
        <Grid item xs={3}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Typography color="textSecondary" gutterBottom>
                Success Rate
              </Typography>
              <Typography variant="h4" color="success.main">
                {agents.length > 0 
                  ? Math.round((statistics.completed / agents.length) * 100)
                  : 0}%
              </Typography>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Grid>
      </Grid>

      {/* Agents Table */}
      <Paper sx={{ width: '100%', overflow: 'hidden' }}>
        <TableContainer>
          <Table>
            <TableHead>
              <TableRow>
                <TableCell>Status</TableCell>
                <TableCell>Agent Name</TableCell>
                <TableCell>Finding</TableCell>
                <TableCell>Severity</TableCell>
                <TableCell>Model</TableCell>
                <TableCell>Progress</TableCell>
                <TableCell>Duration</TableCell>
                <TableCell>Actions</TableCell>
              </TableRow>
            </TableHead>
            <TableBody>
              {agents.map((agent) => (
                <TableRow key={agent.id}>
                  <TableCell>
                    <Chip
                      icon={getStatusIcon(agent.status)}
                      label={agent.status}
                      color={getStatusColor(agent.status) as any}
                      size="small"
                    />
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell>
                    <Typography variant="body2" fontWeight="bold">
                      {agent.name}
                    </Typography>
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell>
                    <Typography variant="body2">
                      {agent.finding_title}
                    </Typography>
                    <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
                      {agent.finding_description.substring(0, 50)}...
                    </Typography>
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell>
                    <Chip 
                      label={agent.severity} 
                      color={getSeverityColor(agent.severity) as any}
                      size="small"
                    />
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell>
                    <Chip label={agent.model} variant="outlined" size="small" />
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell>
                    <Box sx={{ width: '100%' }}>
                      <LinearProgress
                        variant="determinate"
                        value={agent.progress}
                        sx={{ mb: 1 }}
                      />
                      <Typography variant="caption">
                        {agent.progress}%
                      </Typography>
                    </Box>
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell>
                    <Typography variant="body2">
                      {formatDuration(agent.started_at || agent.created_at, agent.completed_at)}
                    </Typography>
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell>
                    <Tooltip title="View Details">
                      <IconButton size="small" onClick={() => { setSelectedAgent(agent); setOpenDetailsDialog(true); }}>
                        <ViewIcon />
                      </IconButton>
                    </Tooltip>
                    {agent.status === 'idle' && (
                      <Tooltip title="Start Agent">
                        <IconButton size="small" onClick={() => startAgent(agent.id)}>
                          <StartIcon />
                        </IconButton>
                      </Tooltip>
                    )}
                    {agent.status === 'running' && (
                      <Tooltip title="Stop Agent">
                        <IconButton size="small" onClick={() => stopAgent(agent.id)}>
                          <StopIcon />
                        </IconButton>
                      </Tooltip>
                    )}
                    {agent.status !== 'running' && (
                      <Tooltip title="Delete Agent">
                        <IconButton size="small" onClick={() => deleteAgent(agent.id)}>
                          <DeleteIcon />
                        </IconButton>
                      </Tooltip>
                    )}
                  </TableCell>
                </TableRow>
              ))}
              {agents.length === 0 && (
                <TableRow>
                  <TableCell colSpan={8} align="center">
                    <Box sx={{ py: 4, textAlign: 'center' }}>
                      <AgentIcon sx={{ fontSize: 48, color: 'text.secondary', mb: 2 }} />
                      <Typography variant="h6" color="text.secondary" gutterBottom>
                        No AI Agents Created Yet
                      </Typography>
                      <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" sx={{ mb: 2 }}>
                        Create your first AI remediation agent to start automating security fixes
                      </Typography>
                      <Button
                        variant="contained"
                        startIcon={<SecurityIcon />}
                        onClick={() => setOpenDialog(true)}
                      >
                        Create First Agent
                      </Button>
                    </Box>
                  </TableCell>
                </TableRow>
              )}
            </TableBody>
          </Table>
        </TableContainer>
      </Paper>

      {/* Create New Agent Dialog */}
      <Dialog open={openDialog} onClose={() => setOpenDialog(false)} maxWidth="md" fullWidth>
        <DialogTitle>Create New AI Remediation Agent</DialogTitle>
        <DialogContent>
          <Grid container spacing={3} sx={{ pt: 2 }}>
            <Grid item xs={12}>
              <TextField
                fullWidth
                label="Finding Title"
                value={newAgent.finding_title}
                onChange={(e) => setNewAgent({ ...newAgent, finding_title: e.target.value })}
                placeholder="e.g., Storage Account Encryption Not Enabled"
                required
              />
            </Grid>
            <Grid item xs={12}>
              <TextField
                fullWidth
                label="Finding Description"
                value={newAgent.finding_description}
                onChange={(e) => setNewAgent({ ...newAgent, finding_description: e.target.value })}
                placeholder="Detailed description of the security finding..."
                multiline
                rows={3}
                required
              />
            </Grid>
            <Grid item xs={6}>
              <FormControl fullWidth>
                <InputLabel>Severity</InputLabel>
                <Select
                  value={newAgent.severity}
                  label="Severity"
                  onChange={(e) => setNewAgent({ ...newAgent, severity: e.target.value })}
                >
                  <MenuItem value="critical">Critical</MenuItem>
                  <MenuItem value="high">High</MenuItem>
                  <MenuItem value="medium">Medium</MenuItem>
                  <MenuItem value="low">Low</MenuItem>
                </Select>
              </FormControl>
            </Grid>
            <Grid item xs={6}>
              <TextField
                fullWidth
                label="Resource Type"
                value={newAgent.resource_type}
                onChange={(e) => setNewAgent({ ...newAgent, resource_type: e.target.value })}
                placeholder="e.g., Storage Account, NSG, Key Vault"
              />
            </Grid>
            <Grid item xs={12}>
              <Divider sx={{ my: 2 }}>
                <Chip label="Agent Configuration" icon={<ConfigIcon />} />
              </Divider>
            </Grid>
            <Grid item xs={6}>
              <FormControl fullWidth>
                <InputLabel>AI Model</InputLabel>
                <Select
                  value={agentConfig.model}
                  label="AI Model"
                  onChange={(e) => setAgentConfig({ ...agentConfig, model: e.target.value })}
                >
                  {Object.entries(availableModels).map(([key, model]) => (
                    <MenuItem key={key} value={key}>
                      <Box>
                        <Typography variant="body2">{model.name}</Typography>
                        <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
                          {model.description}
                        </Typography>
                      </Box>
                    </MenuItem>
                  ))}
                </Select>
              </FormControl>
            </Grid>
            <Grid item xs={6}>
              <TextField
                fullWidth
                label="Temperature"
                type="number"
                value={agentConfig.temperature}
                onChange={(e) => setAgentConfig({ ...agentConfig, temperature: parseFloat(e.target.value) })}
                inputProps={{ min: 0, max: 1, step: 0.1 }}
                helperText="Lower = more consistent, Higher = more creative"
              />
            </Grid>
            <Grid item xs={12}>
              <FormGroup>
                <FormControlLabel
                  control={
                    <Switch
                      checked={agentConfig.validation_mode}
                      onChange={(e) => setAgentConfig({ ...agentConfig, validation_mode: e.target.checked })}
                    />
                  }
                  label="Enable Validation Mode (Recommended)"
                />
                <FormControlLabel
                  control={
                    <Switch
                      checked={agentConfig.enable_logging}
                      onChange={(e) => setAgentConfig({ ...agentConfig, enable_logging: e.target.checked })}
                    />
                  }
                  label="Enable Detailed Logging"
                />
              </FormGroup>
            </Grid>
          </Grid>
        </DialogContent>
        <DialogActions>
          <Button onClick={() => setOpenDialog(false)}>Cancel</Button>
          <Button 
            onClick={createAgent} 
            variant="contained"
            disabled={loading || !newAgent.finding_title || !newAgent.finding_description}
          >
            {loading ? 'Creating...' : 'Create Agent'}
          </Button>
        </DialogActions>
      </Dialog>

      {/* Agent Configuration Dialog */}
      <Dialog open={openConfigDialog} onClose={() => setOpenConfigDialog(false)} maxWidth="md" fullWidth>
        <DialogTitle>Agent Configuration Settings</DialogTitle>
        <DialogContent>
          <Grid container spacing={3} sx={{ pt: 2 }}>
            <Grid item xs={6}>
              <FormControl fullWidth>
                <InputLabel>Default AI Model</InputLabel>
                <Select
                  value={agentConfig.model}
                  label="Default AI Model"
                  onChange={(e) => setAgentConfig({ ...agentConfig, model: e.target.value })}
                >
                  {Object.entries(availableModels).map(([key, model]) => (
                    <MenuItem key={key} value={key}>
                      <Box>
                        <Typography variant="body2">{model.name}</Typography>
                        <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
                          {model.description}
                        </Typography>
                      </Box>
                    </MenuItem>
                  ))}
                </Select>
              </FormControl>
            </Grid>
            <Grid item xs={6}>
              <TextField
                fullWidth
                label="Max Conversation Turns"
                type="number"
                value={agentConfig.max_conversation_turns}
                onChange={(e) => setAgentConfig({ ...agentConfig, max_conversation_turns: parseInt(e.target.value) })}
                inputProps={{ min: 1, max: 20 }}
              />
            </Grid>
            <Grid item xs={6}>
              <TextField
                fullWidth
                label="Default Temperature"
                type="number"
                value={agentConfig.temperature}
                onChange={(e) => setAgentConfig({ ...agentConfig, temperature: parseFloat(e.target.value) })}
                inputProps={{ min: 0, max: 1, step: 0.1 }}
                helperText="Lower = more consistent, Higher = more creative"
              />
            </Grid>
            <Grid item xs={6}>
              <FormControl fullWidth>
                <InputLabel>Validation Mode</InputLabel>
                <Select
                  value={agentConfig.validation_mode ? 'true' : 'false'}
                  label="Validation Mode"
                  onChange={(e) => setAgentConfig({ ...agentConfig, validation_mode: e.target.value === 'true' })}
                >
                  <MenuItem value="true">Enabled (Recommended)</MenuItem>
                  <MenuItem value="false">Disabled</MenuItem>
                </Select>
              </FormControl>
            </Grid>
            <Grid item xs={12}>
              <Alert severity="info" sx={{ mt: 2 }}>
                <Typography variant="body2">
                  <strong>Recommended Settings:</strong> GPT-4 Turbo with temperature 0.1 and validation mode enabled for best results.
                </Typography>
              </Alert>
            </Grid>
          </Grid>
        </DialogContent>
        <DialogActions>
          <Button onClick={() => setOpenConfigDialog(false)}>Cancel</Button>
          <Button onClick={() => setOpenConfigDialog(false)} variant="contained">
            Save Configuration
          </Button>
        </DialogActions>
      </Dialog>

      {/* Agent Details Dialog */}
      <Dialog open={openDetailsDialog} onClose={() => setOpenDetailsDialog(false)} maxWidth="lg" fullWidth>
        <DialogTitle>
          <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
            <AgentIcon />
            Agent Details: {selectedAgent?.name}
          </Box>
        </DialogTitle>
        <DialogContent>
          {selectedAgent && (
            <Grid container spacing={3} sx={{ pt: 2 }}>
              <Grid item xs={12}>
                <Card>
                  <CardContent>
                    <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>Agent Information</Typography>
                    <Grid container spacing={2}>
                      <Grid item xs={6}>
                        <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">Status</Typography>
                        <Chip
                          icon={getStatusIcon(selectedAgent.status)}
                          label={selectedAgent.status}
                          color={getStatusColor(selectedAgent.status) as any}
                          size="small"
                        />
                      </Grid>
                      <Grid item xs={6}>
                        <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">Model</Typography>
                        <Typography variant="body2">{selectedAgent.model}</Typography>
                      </Grid>
                      <Grid item xs={6}>
                        <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">Created</Typography>
                        <Typography variant="body2">
                          {new Date(selectedAgent.created_at).toLocaleString()}
                        </Typography>
                      </Grid>
                      <Grid item xs={6}>
                        <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">Progress</Typography>
                        <Typography variant="body2">{selectedAgent.progress}%</Typography>
                      </Grid>
                    </Grid>
                  </CardContent>
                </Card>
              </Grid>

              <Grid item xs={12}>
                <Card>
                  <CardContent>
                    <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>Finding Details</Typography>
                    <Typography variant="body1" fontWeight="bold" gutterBottom>
                      {selectedAgent.finding_title}
                    </Typography>
                    <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" paragraph>
                      {selectedAgent.finding_description}
                    </Typography>
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', gap: 1 }}>
                      <Chip 
                        label={selectedAgent.severity} 
                        color={getSeverityColor(selectedAgent.severity) as any}
                        size="small"
                      />
                    </Box>
                  </CardContent>
                </Card>
              </Grid>

              {selectedAgent.execution_log.length > 0 && (
                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <Card>
                    <CardContent>
                      <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>Execution Log</Typography>
                      <List dense>
                        {selectedAgent.execution_log.map((log, index) => (
                          <ListItem key={index}>
                            <ListItemIcon>
                              <InfoIcon color="info" />
                            </ListItemIcon>
                            <ListItemText primary={log} />
                          </ListItem>
                        ))}
                      </List>
                    </CardContent>
                  </Card>
                </Grid>
              )}

              {selectedAgent.remediation_plan && (
                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <Card>
                    <CardContent>
                      <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>Remediation Plan</Typography>
                      <Accordion>
                        <AccordionSummary expandIcon={<ExpandMoreIcon />}>
                          <Typography variant="subtitle1">Analysis</Typography>
                        </AccordionSummary>
                        <AccordionDetails>
                          <Typography variant="body2" paragraph>
                            <strong>Current State:</strong> {selectedAgent.remediation_plan.analysis.current_state}
                          </Typography>
                          <Typography variant="body2" paragraph>
                            <strong>Root Cause:</strong> {selectedAgent.remediation_plan.analysis.root_cause}
                          </Typography>
                          <Typography variant="body2">
                            <strong>Risk Assessment:</strong> {selectedAgent.remediation_plan.analysis.risk_assessment}
                          </Typography>
                        </AccordionDetails>
                      </Accordion>

                      <Accordion>
                        <AccordionSummary expandIcon={<ExpandMoreIcon />}>
                          <Typography variant="subtitle1">Remediation Steps</Typography>
                        </AccordionSummary>
                        <AccordionDetails>
                          {selectedAgent.remediation_plan.remediation_plan.steps.map((step: any, index: number) => (
                            <Box key={index} sx={{ mb: 2, p: 2, border: '1px solid #e0e0e0', borderRadius: 1 }}>
                              <Typography variant="subtitle2" gutterBottom>
                                Step {step.step_number}: {step.action}
                              </Typography>
                              <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" paragraph>
                                <strong>Command:</strong> {step.command}
                              </Typography>
                              <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" paragraph>
                                <strong>Validation:</strong> {step.validation}
                              </Typography>
                              <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                                <strong>Estimated Time:</strong> {step.estimated_time}
                              </Typography>
                            </Box>
                          ))}
                        </AccordionDetails>
                      </Accordion>

                      <Accordion>
                        <AccordionSummary expandIcon={<ExpandMoreIcon />}>
                          <Typography variant="subtitle1">Documentation</Typography>
                        </AccordionSummary>
                        <AccordionDetails>
                          <Typography variant="body2" paragraph>
                            <strong>Changes Made:</strong> {selectedAgent.remediation_plan.documentation.changes_made}
                          </Typography>
                          <Typography variant="body2" paragraph>
                            <strong>Compliance Status:</strong> {selectedAgent.remediation_plan.documentation.compliance_status}
                          </Typography>
                          <Typography variant="body2">
                            <strong>Recommendations:</strong>
                          </Typography>
                          <List dense>
                            {selectedAgent.remediation_plan.documentation.recommendations.map((rec: string, index: number) => (
                              <ListItem key={index}>
                                <ListItemIcon>
                                  <InfoIcon color="info" />
                                </ListItemIcon>
                                <ListItemText primary={rec} />
                              </ListItem>
                            ))}
                          </List>
                        </AccordionDetails>
                      </Accordion>
                    </CardContent>
                  </Card>
                </Grid>
              )}
            </Grid>
          )}
        </DialogContent>
        <DialogActions>
          <Button onClick={() => setOpenDetailsDialog(false)}>Close</Button>
        </DialogActions>
      </Dialog>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default AgenticPage;
```

```typescript
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  Box,
  Typography,
  Paper,
  Button,
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableContainer,
  TableHead,
  TableRow,
  Chip,
  IconButton,
  Dialog,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogContent,
  DialogActions,
  TextField,
  FormControl,
  InputLabel,
  Select,
  MenuItem,
  LinearProgress,
  Alert,
  Card,
  CardContent,
  Grid,
  Tooltip,
  Accordion,
  AccordionSummary,
  AccordionDetails,
  List,
  ListItem,
  ListItemText,
  ListItemIcon,
  Divider,
  Badge,
  Switch,
  FormControlLabel,
  FormGroup
} from '@mui/material';
import {
  PlayArrow as StartIcon,
  Stop as StopIcon,
  Visibility as ViewIcon,
  Settings as ConfigIcon,
  Security as SecurityIcon,
  CheckCircle as SuccessIcon,
  Error as ErrorIcon,
  Schedule as PendingIcon,
  Delete as DeleteIcon,
  ExpandMore as ExpandMoreIcon,
  SmartToy as AgentIcon,
  Psychology as AIIcon,
  Code as CodeIcon,
  Assessment as AssessmentIcon,
  Timeline as TimelineIcon,
  Warning as WarningIcon,
  Info as InfoIcon
} from '@mui/icons-material';

interface Agent {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  status: 'idle' | 'running' | 'completed' | 'failed' | 'stopped';
  finding_id: string;
  finding_title: string;
  finding_description: string;
  severity: string;
  model: string;
  progress: number;
  created_at: string;
  started_at?: string;
  completed_at?: string;
  config: any;
  remediation_plan?: any;
  execution_log: string[];
  agent_prompt?: string;
}

interface AgentModel {
  name: string;
  description: string;
  max_tokens: number;
  temperature: number;
}

interface AgentStatistics {
  running: number;
  completed: number;
  failed: number;
  idle: number;
}

const AgenticPage: React.FC = () => {
  const [agents, setAgents] = useState<Agent[]>([]);
  const [selectedAgent, setSelectedAgent] = useState<Agent | null>(null);
  const [openDialog, setOpenDialog] = useState(false);
  const [openConfigDialog, setOpenConfigDialog] = useState(false);
  const [openDetailsDialog, setOpenDetailsDialog] = useState(false);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [statistics, setStatistics] = useState<AgentStatistics>({ running: 0, completed: 0, failed: 0, idle: 0 });
  const [availableModels, setAvailableModels] = useState<Record<string, AgentModel>>({});

  // Agent configuration
  const [agentConfig, setAgentConfig] = useState({
    model: 'gpt-4-1106-preview',
    max_conversation_turns: 10,
    temperature: 0.1,
    auto_execute: false,
    validation_mode: true,
    enable_logging: true
  });

  // New agent form
  const [newAgent, setNewAgent] = useState({
    finding_title: '',
    finding_description: '',
    severity: 'medium',
    resource_type: 'unknown'
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchAgents();
    fetchAgentModels();
    const interval = setInterval(fetchAgents, 5000); // Refresh every 5 seconds
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, []);

  const fetchAgents = async () => {
    try {
      const response = await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:9099/api/v1/agents');
      const data = await response.json();
      setAgents(data.agents || []);
      setStatistics(data.statistics || { running: 0, completed: 0, failed: 0, idle: 0 });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error fetching agents:', error);
    }
  };

  const fetchAgentModels = async () => {
    try {
      const response = await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:9099/api/v1/agents/models');
      const data = await response.json();
      setAvailableModels(data.models || {});
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error fetching agent models:', error);
    }
  };

  const createAgent = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const response = await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:9099/api/v1/agents', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          finding_id: `finding-${Date.now()}`,
          finding_title: newAgent.finding_title,
          finding_description: newAgent.finding_description,
          severity: newAgent.severity,
          resource_type: newAgent.resource_type,
          config: agentConfig
        }),
      });

      if (response.ok) {
        const result = await response.json();
        console.log('Agent created:', result);
        await fetchAgents();
        setOpenDialog(false);
        resetNewAgentForm();
      } else {
        console.error('Failed to create agent');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error creating agent:', error);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const resetNewAgentForm = () => {
    setNewAgent({
      finding_title: '',
      finding_description: '',
      severity: 'medium',
      resource_type: 'unknown'
    });
  };

  const startAgent = async (agentId: string) => {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:9099/api/v1/agents/${agentId}/start`, {
        method: 'POST'
      });
      if (response.ok) {
        await fetchAgents();
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error starting agent:', error);
    }
  };

  const stopAgent = async (agentId: string) => {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:9099/api/v1/agents/${agentId}/stop`, {
        method: 'POST'
      });
      if (response.ok) {
        await fetchAgents();
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error stopping agent:', error);
    }
  };

  const deleteAgent = async (agentId: string) => {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:9099/api/v1/agents/${agentId}`, {
        method: 'DELETE'
      });
      if (response.ok) {
        await fetchAgents();
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error deleting agent:', error);
    }
  };

  const getStatusIcon = (status: string) => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'running':
        return <LinearProgress size={20} />;
      case 'completed':
        return <SuccessIcon color="success" />;
      case 'failed':
        return <ErrorIcon color="error" />;
      case 'stopped':
        return <StopIcon color="action" />;
      default:
        return <PendingIcon color="info" />;
    }
  };

  const getStatusColor = (status: string) => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'running':
        return 'primary';
      case 'completed':
        return 'success';
      case 'failed':
        return 'error';
      case 'stopped':
        return 'default';
      default:
        return 'info';
    }
  };

  const getSeverityColor = (severity: string) => {
    switch (severity.toLowerCase()) {
      case 'critical':
        return 'error';
      case 'high':
        return 'warning';
      case 'medium':
        return 'info';
      case 'low':
        return 'success';
      default:
        return 'default';
    }
  };

  const formatDuration = (startTime: string, endTime?: string) => {
    if (!startTime) return 'N/A';
    
    const start = new Date(startTime);
    const end = endTime ? new Date(endTime) : new Date();
    const diff = end.getTime() - start.getTime();
    
    const minutes = Math.floor(diff / 60000);
    const seconds = Math.floor((diff % 60000) / 1000);
    
    if (minutes > 0) {
      return `${minutes}m ${seconds}s`;
    }
    return `${seconds}s`;
  };

  return (
    <Box sx={{ p: 3 }}>
      <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', mb: 3 }}>
        <Box>
          <Typography variant="h4" component="h1" sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
            <AgentIcon color="primary" />
            Agentic - AI Remediation Agents
          </Typography>
          <Typography variant="body1" color="text.secondary" sx={{ mt: 1 }}>
            Intelligent AI agents for automated security remediation and compliance
          </Typography>
        </Box>
        <Box>
          <Button
            variant="outlined"
            startIcon={<ConfigIcon />}
            onClick={() => setOpenConfigDialog(true)}
            sx={{ mr: 2 }}
          >
            Agent Settings
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant="contained"
            startIcon={<SecurityIcon />}
            onClick={() => setOpenDialog(true)}
          >
            Create New Agent
          </Button>
        </Box>
      </Box>

      {/* Agent Statistics */}
      <Grid container spacing={3} sx={{ mb: 3 }}>
        <Grid item xs={3}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Typography color="textSecondary" gutterBottom>
                Total Agents
              </Typography>
              <Typography variant="h4">
                {agents.length}
              </Typography>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Grid>
        <Grid item xs={3}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Typography color="textSecondary" gutterBottom>
                Running
              </Typography>
              <Typography variant="h4" color="primary">
                {statistics.running}
              </Typography>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Grid>
        <Grid item xs={3}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Typography color="textSecondary" gutterBottom>
                Completed
              </Typography>
              <Typography variant="h4" color="success.main">
                {statistics.completed}
              </Typography>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Grid>
        <Grid item xs={3}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Typography color="textSecondary" gutterBottom>
                Success Rate
              </Typography>
              <Typography variant="h4" color="success.main">
                {agents.length > 0 
                  ? Math.round((statistics.completed / agents.length) * 100)
                  : 0}%
              </Typography>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Grid>
      </Grid>

      {/* Agents Table */}
      <Paper sx={{ width: '100%', overflow: 'hidden' }}>
        <TableContainer>
          <Table>
            <TableHead>
              <TableRow>
                <TableCell>Status</TableCell>
                <TableCell>Agent Name</TableCell>
                <TableCell>Finding</TableCell>
                <TableCell>Severity</TableCell>
                <TableCell>Model</TableCell>
                <TableCell>Progress</TableCell>
                <TableCell>Duration</TableCell>
                <TableCell>Actions</TableCell>
              </TableRow>
            </TableHead>
            <TableBody>
              {agents.map((agent) => (
                <TableRow key={agent.id}>
                  <TableCell>
                    <Chip
                      icon={getStatusIcon(agent.status)}
                      label={agent.status}
                      color={getStatusColor(agent.status) as any}
                      size="small"
                    />
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell>
                    <Typography variant="body2" fontWeight="bold">
                      {agent.name}
                    </Typography>
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell>
                    <Typography variant="body2">
                      {agent.finding_title}
                    </Typography>
                    <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
                      {agent.finding_description.substring(0, 50)}...
                    </Typography>
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell>
                    <Chip 
                      label={agent.severity} 
                      color={getSeverityColor(agent.severity) as any}
                      size="small"
                    />
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell>
                    <Chip label={agent.model} variant="outlined" size="small" />
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell>
                    <Box sx={{ width: '100%' }}>
                      <LinearProgress
                        variant="determinate"
                        value={agent.progress}
                        sx={{ mb: 1 }}
                      />
                      <Typography variant="caption">
                        {agent.progress}%
                      </Typography>
                    </Box>
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell>
                    <Typography variant="body2">
                      {formatDuration(agent.started_at || agent.created_at, agent.completed_at)}
                    </Typography>
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell>
                    <Tooltip title="View Details">
                      <IconButton size="small" onClick={() => { setSelectedAgent(agent); setOpenDetailsDialog(true); }}>
                        <ViewIcon />
                      </IconButton>
                    </Tooltip>
                    {agent.status === 'idle' && (
                      <Tooltip title="Start Agent">
                        <IconButton size="small" onClick={() => startAgent(agent.id)}>
                          <StartIcon />
                        </IconButton>
                      </Tooltip>
                    )}
                    {agent.status === 'running' && (
                      <Tooltip title="Stop Agent">
                        <IconButton size="small" onClick={() => stopAgent(agent.id)}>
                          <StopIcon />
                        </IconButton>
                      </Tooltip>
                    )}
                    {agent.status !== 'running' && (
                      <Tooltip title="Delete Agent">
                        <IconButton size="small" onClick={() => deleteAgent(agent.id)}>
                          <DeleteIcon />
                        </IconButton>
                      </Tooltip>
                    )}
                  </TableCell>
                </TableRow>
              ))}
              {agents.length === 0 && (
                <TableRow>
                  <TableCell colSpan={8} align="center">
                    <Box sx={{ py: 4, textAlign: 'center' }}>
                      <AgentIcon sx={{ fontSize: 48, color: 'text.secondary', mb: 2 }} />
                      <Typography variant="h6" color="text.secondary" gutterBottom>
                        No AI Agents Created Yet
                      </Typography>
                      <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" sx={{ mb: 2 }}>
                        Create your first AI remediation agent to start automating security fixes
                      </Typography>
                      <Button
                        variant="contained"
                        startIcon={<SecurityIcon />}
                        onClick={() => setOpenDialog(true)}
                      >
                        Create First Agent
                      </Button>
                    </Box>
                  </TableCell>
                </TableRow>
              )}
            </TableBody>
          </Table>
        </TableContainer>
      </Paper>

      {/* Create New Agent Dialog */}
      <Dialog open={openDialog} onClose={() => setOpenDialog(false)} maxWidth="md" fullWidth>
        <DialogTitle>Create New AI Remediation Agent</DialogTitle>
        <DialogContent>
          <Grid container spacing={3} sx={{ pt: 2 }}>
            <Grid item xs={12}>
              <TextField
                fullWidth
                label="Finding Title"
                value={newAgent.finding_title}
                onChange={(e) => setNewAgent({ ...newAgent, finding_title: e.target.value })}
                placeholder="e.g., Storage Account Encryption Not Enabled"
                required
              />
            </Grid>
            <Grid item xs={12}>
              <TextField
                fullWidth
                label="Finding Description"
                value={newAgent.finding_description}
                onChange={(e) => setNewAgent({ ...newAgent, finding_description: e.target.value })}
                placeholder="Detailed description of the security finding..."
                multiline
                rows={3}
                required
              />
            </Grid>
            <Grid item xs={6}>
              <FormControl fullWidth>
                <InputLabel>Severity</InputLabel>
                <Select
                  value={newAgent.severity}
                  label="Severity"
                  onChange={(e) => setNewAgent({ ...newAgent, severity: e.target.value })}
                >
                  <MenuItem value="critical">Critical</MenuItem>
                  <MenuItem value="high">High</MenuItem>
                  <MenuItem value="medium">Medium</MenuItem>
                  <MenuItem value="low">Low</MenuItem>
                </Select>
              </FormControl>
            </Grid>
            <Grid item xs={6}>
              <TextField
                fullWidth
                label="Resource Type"
                value={newAgent.resource_type}
                onChange={(e) => setNewAgent({ ...newAgent, resource_type: e.target.value })}
                placeholder="e.g., Storage Account, NSG, Key Vault"
              />
            </Grid>
            <Grid item xs={12}>
              <Divider sx={{ my: 2 }}>
                <Chip label="Agent Configuration" icon={<ConfigIcon />} />
              </Divider>
            </Grid>
            <Grid item xs={6}>
              <FormControl fullWidth>
                <InputLabel>AI Model</InputLabel>
                <Select
                  value={agentConfig.model}
                  label="AI Model"
                  onChange={(e) => setAgentConfig({ ...agentConfig, model: e.target.value })}
                >
                  {Object.entries(availableModels).map(([key, model]) => (
                    <MenuItem key={key} value={key}>
                      <Box>
                        <Typography variant="body2">{model.name}</Typography>
                        <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
                          {model.description}
                        </Typography>
                      </Box>
                    </MenuItem>
                  ))}
                </Select>
              </FormControl>
            </Grid>
            <Grid item xs={6}>
              <TextField
                fullWidth
                label="Temperature"
                type="number"
                value={agentConfig.temperature}
                onChange={(e) => setAgentConfig({ ...agentConfig, temperature: parseFloat(e.target.value) })}
                inputProps={{ min: 0, max: 1, step: 0.1 }}
                helperText="Lower = more consistent, Higher = more creative"
              />
            </Grid>
            <Grid item xs={12}>
              <FormGroup>
                <FormControlLabel
                  control={
                    <Switch
                      checked={agentConfig.validation_mode}
                      onChange={(e) => setAgentConfig({ ...agentConfig, validation_mode: e.target.checked })}
                    />
                  }
                  label="Enable Validation Mode (Recommended)"
                />
                <FormControlLabel
                  control={
                    <Switch
                      checked={agentConfig.enable_logging}
                      onChange={(e) => setAgentConfig({ ...agentConfig, enable_logging: e.target.checked })}
                    />
                  }
                  label="Enable Detailed Logging"
                />
              </FormGroup>
            </Grid>
          </Grid>
        </DialogContent>
        <DialogActions>
          <Button onClick={() => setOpenDialog(false)}>Cancel</Button>
          <Button 
            onClick={createAgent} 
            variant="contained"
            disabled={loading || !newAgent.finding_title || !newAgent.finding_description}
          >
            {loading ? 'Creating...' : 'Create Agent'}
          </Button>
        </DialogActions>
      </Dialog>

      {/* Agent Configuration Dialog */}
      <Dialog open={openConfigDialog} onClose={() => setOpenConfigDialog(false)} maxWidth="md" fullWidth>
        <DialogTitle>Agent Configuration Settings</DialogTitle>
        <DialogContent>
          <Grid container spacing={3} sx={{ pt: 2 }}>
            <Grid item xs={6}>
              <FormControl fullWidth>
                <InputLabel>Default AI Model</InputLabel>
                <Select
                  value={agentConfig.model}
                  label="Default AI Model"
                  onChange={(e) => setAgentConfig({ ...agentConfig, model: e.target.value })}
                >
                  {Object.entries(availableModels).map(([key, model]) => (
                    <MenuItem key={key} value={key}>
                      <Box>
                        <Typography variant="body2">{model.name}</Typography>
                        <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
                          {model.description}
                        </Typography>
                      </Box>
                    </MenuItem>
                  ))}
                </Select>
              </FormControl>
            </Grid>
            <Grid item xs={6}>
              <TextField
                fullWidth
                label="Max Conversation Turns"
                type="number"
                value={agentConfig.max_conversation_turns}
                onChange={(e) => setAgentConfig({ ...agentConfig, max_conversation_turns: parseInt(e.target.value) })}
                inputProps={{ min: 1, max: 20 }}
              />
            </Grid>
            <Grid item xs={6}>
              <TextField
                fullWidth
                label="Default Temperature"
                type="number"
                value={agentConfig.temperature}
                onChange={(e) => setAgentConfig({ ...agentConfig, temperature: parseFloat(e.target.value) })}
                inputProps={{ min: 0, max: 1, step: 0.1 }}
                helperText="Lower = more consistent, Higher = more creative"
              />
            </Grid>
            <Grid item xs={6}>
              <FormControl fullWidth>
                <InputLabel>Validation Mode</InputLabel>
                <Select
                  value={agentConfig.validation_mode ? 'true' : 'false'}
                  label="Validation Mode"
                  onChange={(e) => setAgentConfig({ ...agentConfig, validation_mode: e.target.value === 'true' })}
                >
                  <MenuItem value="true">Enabled (Recommended)</MenuItem>
                  <MenuItem value="false">Disabled</MenuItem>
                </Select>
              </FormControl>
            </Grid>
            <Grid item xs={12}>
              <Alert severity="info" sx={{ mt: 2 }}>
                <Typography variant="body2">
                  <strong>Recommended Settings:</strong> GPT-4 Turbo with temperature 0.1 and validation mode enabled for best results.
                </Typography>
              </Alert>
            </Grid>
          </Grid>
        </DialogContent>
        <DialogActions>
          <Button onClick={() => setOpenConfigDialog(false)}>Cancel</Button>
          <Button onClick={() => setOpenConfigDialog(false)} variant="contained">
            Save Configuration
          </Button>
        </DialogActions>
      </Dialog>

      {/* Agent Details Dialog */}
      <Dialog open={openDetailsDialog} onClose={() => setOpenDetailsDialog(false)} maxWidth="lg" fullWidth>
        <DialogTitle>
          <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
            <AgentIcon />
            Agent Details: {selectedAgent?.name}
          </Box>
        </DialogTitle>
        <DialogContent>
          {selectedAgent && (
            <Grid container spacing={3} sx={{ pt: 2 }}>
              <Grid item xs={12}>
                <Card>
                  <CardContent>
                    <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>Agent Information</Typography>
                    <Grid container spacing={2}>
                      <Grid item xs={6}>
                        <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">Status</Typography>
                        <Chip
                          icon={getStatusIcon(selectedAgent.status)}
                          label={selectedAgent.status}
                          color={getStatusColor(selectedAgent.status) as any}
                          size="small"
                        />
                      </Grid>
                      <Grid item xs={6}>
                        <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">Model</Typography>
                        <Typography variant="body2">{selectedAgent.model}</Typography>
                      </Grid>
                      <Grid item xs={6}>
                        <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">Created</Typography>
                        <Typography variant="body2">
                          {new Date(selectedAgent.created_at).toLocaleString()}
                        </Typography>
                      </Grid>
                      <Grid item xs={6}>
                        <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">Progress</Typography>
                        <Typography variant="body2">{selectedAgent.progress}%</Typography>
                      </Grid>
                    </Grid>
                  </CardContent>
                </Card>
              </Grid>

              <Grid item xs={12}>
                <Card>
                  <CardContent>
                    <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>Finding Details</Typography>
                    <Typography variant="body1" fontWeight="bold" gutterBottom>
                      {selectedAgent.finding_title}
                    </Typography>
                    <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" paragraph>
                      {selectedAgent.finding_description}
                    </Typography>
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', gap: 1 }}>
                      <Chip 
                        label={selectedAgent.severity} 
                        color={getSeverityColor(selectedAgent.severity) as any}
                        size="small"
                      />
                    </Box>
                  </CardContent>
                </Card>
              </Grid>

              {selectedAgent.execution_log.length > 0 && (
                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <Card>
                    <CardContent>
                      <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>Execution Log</Typography>
                      <List dense>
                        {selectedAgent.execution_log.map((log, index) => (
                          <ListItem key={index}>
                            <ListItemIcon>
                              <InfoIcon color="info" />
                            </ListItemIcon>
                            <ListItemText primary={log} />
                          </ListItem>
                        ))}
                      </List>
                    </CardContent>
                  </Card>
                </Grid>
              )}

              {selectedAgent.remediation_plan && (
                <Grid item xs={12}>
                  <Card>
                    <CardContent>
                      <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>Remediation Plan</Typography>
                      <Accordion>
                        <AccordionSummary expandIcon={<ExpandMoreIcon />}>
                          <Typography variant="subtitle1">Analysis</Typography>
                        </AccordionSummary>
                        <AccordionDetails>
                          <Typography variant="body2" paragraph>
                            <strong>Current State:</strong> {selectedAgent.remediation_plan.analysis.current_state}
                          </Typography>
                          <Typography variant="body2" paragraph>
                            <strong>Root Cause:</strong> {selectedAgent.remediation_plan.analysis.root_cause}
                          </Typography>
                          <Typography variant="body2">
                            <strong>Risk Assessment:</strong> {selectedAgent.remediation_plan.analysis.risk_assessment}
                          </Typography>
                        </AccordionDetails>
                      </Accordion>

                      <Accordion>
                        <AccordionSummary expandIcon={<ExpandMoreIcon />}>
                          <Typography variant="subtitle1">Remediation Steps</Typography>
                        </AccordionSummary>
                        <AccordionDetails>
                          {selectedAgent.remediation_plan.remediation_plan.steps.map((step: any, index: number) => (
                            <Box key={index} sx={{ mb: 2, p: 2, border: '1px solid #e0e0e0', borderRadius: 1 }}>
                              <Typography variant="subtitle2" gutterBottom>
                                Step {step.step_number}: {step.action}
                              </Typography>
                              <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" paragraph>
                                <strong>Command:</strong> {step.command}
                              </Typography>
                              <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" paragraph>
                                <strong>Validation:</strong> {step.validation}
                              </Typography>
                              <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                                <strong>Estimated Time:</strong> {step.estimated_time}
                              </Typography>
                            </Box>
                          ))}
                        </AccordionDetails>
                      </Accordion>

                      <Accordion>
                        <AccordionSummary expandIcon={<ExpandMoreIcon />}>
                          <Typography variant="subtitle1">Documentation</Typography>
                        </AccordionSummary>
                        <AccordionDetails>
                          <Typography variant="body2" paragraph>
                            <strong>Changes Made:</strong> {selectedAgent.remediation_plan.documentation.changes_made}
                          </Typography>
                          <Typography variant="body2" paragraph>
                            <strong>Compliance Status:</strong> {selectedAgent.remediation_plan.documentation.compliance_status}
                          </Typography>
                          <Typography variant="body2">
                            <strong>Recommendations:</strong>
                          </Typography>
                          <List dense>
                            {selectedAgent.remediation_plan.documentation.recommendations.map((rec: string, index: number) => (
                              <ListItem key={index}>
                                <ListItemIcon>
                                  <InfoIcon color="info" />
                                </ListItemIcon>
                                <ListItemText primary={rec} />
                              </ListItem>
                            ))}
                          </List>
                        </AccordionDetails>
                      </Accordion>
                    </CardContent>
                  </Card>
                </Grid>
              )}
            </Grid>
          )}
        </DialogContent>
        <DialogActions>
          <Button onClick={() => setOpenDetailsDialog(false)}>Close</Button>
        </DialogActions>
      </Dialog>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default AgenticPage;

import React from 'react'
import { Routes, Route, Navigate } from 'react-router-dom'
import { Box } from '@mui/material'

import { useAuth } from './contexts/AuthContext'
import Layout from './components/Layout/Layout'
import LoginPage from './pages/LoginPage'
import DashboardPage from './pages/DashboardPage'
import ScansPage from './pages/ScansPage'
import ScanDetailPage from './pages/ScanDetailPage'
import ReportsPage from './pages/ReportsPage'
import ChatbotPage from './pages/ChatbotPage'
import AgenticPage from './pages/AgenticPage'
import SettingsPage from './pages/SettingsPage'
import NotFoundPage from './pages/NotFoundPage'

// ... existing code ...

const App: React.FC = () => {
  return (
    <Box sx={{ minHeight: '100vh', backgroundColor: 'background.default' }}>
      <Routes>
        {/* Public routes */}
        <Route path="/login" element={<LoginPage />} />
        
        {/* Protected routes */}
        <Route
          path="/"
          element={
            <ProtectedRoute>
              <Layout />
            </ProtectedRoute>
          }
        >
          <Route index element={<Navigate to="/dashboard" replace />} />
          <Route path="dashboard" element={<DashboardPage />} />
          <Route path="scans" element={<ScansPage />} />
          <Route path="scans/:scanId" element={<ScanDetailPage />} />
          <Route path="reports" element={<ReportsPage />} />
          <Route path="chatbot" element={<ChatbotPage />} />
          <Route path="agentic" element={<AgenticPage />} />
          <Route path="settings" element={<SettingsPage />} />
        </Route>

        {/* 404 route */}
        <Route path="*" element={<NotFoundPage />} />
      </Routes>
    </Box>
  )
}

export default App

import React from 'react'
import { Routes, Route, Navigate } from 'react-router-dom'
import { Box } from '@mui/material'

import { useAuth } from './contexts/AuthContext'
import Layout from './components/Layout/Layout'
import LoginPage from './pages/LoginPage'
import DashboardPage from './pages/DashboardPage'
import ScansPage from './pages/ScansPage'
import ScanDetailPage from './pages/ScanDetailPage'
import ReportsPage from './pages/ReportsPage'
import ChatbotPage from './pages/ChatbotPage'
import AgenticPage from './pages/AgenticPage'
import SettingsPage from './pages/SettingsPage'
import NotFoundPage from './pages/NotFoundPage'

// ... existing code ...

const App: React.FC = () => {
  return (
    <Box sx={{ minHeight: '100vh', backgroundColor: 'background.default' }}>
      <Routes>
        {/* Public routes */}
        <Route path="/login" element={<LoginPage />} />
        
        {/* Protected routes */}
        <Route
          path="/"
          element={
            <ProtectedRoute>
              <Layout />
            </ProtectedRoute>
          }
        >
          <Route index element={<Navigate to="/dashboard" replace />} />
          <Route path="dashboard" element={<DashboardPage />} />
          <Route path="scans" element={<ScansPage />} />
          <Route path="scans/:scanId" element={<ScanDetailPage />} />
          <Route path="reports" element={<ReportsPage />} />
          <Route path="chatbot" element={<ChatbotPage />} />
          <Route path="agentic" element={<AgenticPage />} />
          <Route path="settings" element={<SettingsPage />} />
        </Route>

        {/* 404 route */}
        <Route path="*" element={<NotFoundPage />} />
      </Routes>
    </Box>
  )
}

export default App
